scope: two local ARM64 bootloader source builds only; not installation or hardware qualification
toolchain: Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 local VM; GCC 13.3.0, GNU ld 2.42, rustc 1.99.0; aarch64-unknown-none-softfloat
configuration: RELEASE=1 LOGO= NO_DISPLAY=1; CHAINLOADING=0 for stage 2 and CHAINLOADING=1 for stage 1
verification: Both build_cfg.h files contain NO_DISPLAY; only stage 1 contains CHAINLOADING. The two stages differ, and the corrected builder produced byte-identical outputs in a second fresh checkout. Existing source build data and in-source output were rejected.
initial_failure: The earlier Elementary wrapper reused stage 2 output when switching make variables; its configuration guard failed. The corrected builder runs make clean on its own newly generated build directory between stages.
limitations: Gravity package manifest pins a different bootloader commit
no physical boot or HDMI test
